True freedom unwritten hoti hai.
Khushi pyaar ka shaant phool hai.
Khushi hamari halat mein nahi, hamare khud ke andar hai.
Khushi achhi tarah bitaayi gayi zindagi ki goonj hai.
Azadi durlabh hai.
Khushi yeh ehsaas hai ki sab sahi chal raha hai.
Ek aazad samaj woh hai jahan unpopular hona bhi safe ho.
Khushi har jagah hai.
Aazadi hathiyaron se nahi, logon se milti hai.
Khushi ek garam bandook hai.
Azadi bahadur hai.
Khushi sarvashaktimaan taakat hai.
Joy aatma ka ek phal hai.
Khushi kismat ki nahi, chunav ki baat hai.
Azaadi sawal poochne ka haq hai.
Sabse badi aazadi alag tarah se sochne ka haq hai.
Azadi bandhan mukt hona hai.
Khushi choti choti cheezon ki sarahana karne ki kala hai.
Khushi achhe se bitaye din ka inaam hai.
Mujhe wahan dhoondo jahan signal mare aur joy jeeye.
Happiness baarish mein laga tent hai.
Azadi khula raasta hai.
Sabse badi khushi apni bhavnaon ko ek conscious state mein badalna hai.
Khushi unchi hai.
Sachhi khushi ek shaant dil hai.
Sabse khush log woh hain jinhe khush hone ki koi wajah nahi chahiye.
